question: Which river has the tributaries by the name of Mayurakshi, Damodar, Kangsabati and Rupnarayan?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Hooghly.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Hooghly** has the tributaries by the name of Mayurakshi, Damodar, Kangsabati and Rupnarayan.
 
• The Mayurakshi, Ajay, Damodar, Kangsabati, Rupnarayan and their tributaries which rise in the Western plateau and high lands flow eastwards through the different districts of West Bengal and joins the Bhagir
